note: Bidirectional streaming: a started request producer whose body outlived the dispatch without being polled no longer blocks forever on the full channel (and no longer makes the dispatch wait the 2 s join grace); it gives up the send once the dispatch finished, drops its sender and frees its blocking thread, producer slot and pull closure. C ABI: an async dispatch dropped by vespera_shutdown releases its in-flight slot before its 503 callback, like a normal completion; vespera.h documents that vespera_shutdown called on a runtime worker returns without waiting. Stronger tests and corrected bench docs
